transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Ever since they changed everything at school, I feel like I’m not handling it well at all and my reactions to the stress are taking over my life. I just don't feel like myself anymore, and it's starting to affect everything I do.
Did these feelings start soon after the changes at school, or were you already feeling this way before? And if the school stress were removed, do you think your symptoms would mostly improve?

Yes, it started very quickly—within a few weeks of the restructuring announcement, I went from being my usual grounded self to crying in the parking lot before school. I really believe that if they eased up on these new demands or let me go back to my old way of teaching, I would finally be able to calm down and feel like myself again.
How has this stress been affecting your day-to-day functioning at work, at home, or in your relationships? Has it caused you to miss work, avoid people, or struggle to keep up with responsibilities?

It’s severely impacting my daily life; my lesson planning has slowed down so much that I'm staying up late every night just to keep up, and my principal has even noticed I seem disengaged in class. At home, I’m so exhausted and irritable that I’ve been skipping family gatherings and barely talking to my husband in the evenings.

Besides the school changes, was there any other major stressor or traumatic event around that time, such as a loss, accident, assault, or serious illness? Also, have you been having nightmares, flashbacks, or feeling constantly on guard?

No, there hasn't been any other major loss or traumatic event; it really is just the school changes that have done this. I don't have any nightmares or flashbacks, and I don't feel constantly on guard, it's just this overwhelming stress from work that I can't seem to shake.

How long has this been going on since the school changes started? Has it lasted less than 6 months, or has it continued for more than 6 months even after the stress at school stayed the same or got better?

This has been going on for about five months now, ever since they rolled out all the changes at my school. So it has been less than six months, and I really feel that if the intense pressure and demands at work would just ease up, I would finally be able to calm down and recover.

final_diagnosis.reason: Symptoms began within weeks of an identifiable psychosocial stressor (school restructuring), are clearly linked to that stressor, cause marked occupational and interpersonal impairment, and have persisted for about five months without evidence of trauma-related re-experiencing/hyperarousal or another major precipitating event. This is most consistent with adjustment disorder.
